recipes.title: Garlic Naan Butter Chicken
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, and black pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned; pour in the butter chicken sauce and simmer until the chicken is tender and cooked through, then serve alongside cooked white rice and warmed garlic naan.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Wraps
instructions: Toss the pulled chicken with the buffalo sauce in a pan over low heat until fully coated and warm, then divide the mixture evenly among the 4 tortillas, top with shredded lettuce, cheddar cheese, and ranch dressing, and fold tightly into wraps to serve.
Put tortillas back on the pan for a few minutes to crisp edges.

recipes.title: Honey Black Pepper Chicken Mac
instructions: Boil the elbow noodles according to package instructions, drain, and stir in the evaporated milk, cheddar, and mozzarella over low heat until smooth and creamy; meanwhile, cook the seasoned chicken thighs in a pan, glaze them with the mixture of honey, soy sauce, apple cider vinegar, black pepper, and spices, then mix the glazed chicken directly into the mac and cheese.

recipes.title: Protein Overnight Oats
instructions: mix together the rolled oats, milk, protein powder, chia seeds, peanut butter, syrup, and cinnamon in a large bowl or mason jars until smooth, then cover and refrigerate overnight (or at least 6 hours) before topping with sliced banana and blueberries to serve.

recipes.title: Philly Cheesesteak
instructions: Sauté the sliced onion and green peppers in a hot skillet until tender, then add the thinly sliced beef and cook until browned; mix everything together, top with cheese to melt, and scoop into hoagie rolls.

recipes.title: Korean Beef Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook the white rice according to package instructions, and in a separate skillet, brown the ground beef in canola oil with salt and pepper; stir in the minced garlic, soy sauce, brown sugar, and sesame oil, simmering until the sauce thickens and coats the meat.
Divide the beef over the cooked rice, top each bowl with a fried egg and sliced green onions, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Honey Siracha Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Dice the chicken breast, toss with salt, onion powder, and cornstarch, then sear in a hot skillet until cooked through; whisk together the soy sauce, honey, sriracha, and rice vinegar to make the glaze, coating the chicken before setting it aside.

In the same pan, scramble the eggs and sauté the mixed vegetables, then add the cooked white rice, minced garlic, and sesame oil, stir-frying until crispy before tossing everything together with the glazed chicken.

recipes.title: Cheesy Chorizo Quesadilla
instructions: Remove the chorizo from its casing and cook in a skillet over medium heat until fully browned and cooked through, then remove and drain excess fat.

Place a tortilla flat in a dry skillet over medium heat, sprinkle half with mozzarella and cooked chorizo, fold in half, and cook for 2–3 minutes per side until crisp and melted (repeat for all tortillas).

recipes.title: Meatball Subs
instructions: Simmer the cooked meatballs in the marinara sauce over medium-low heat for 8–10 minutes until heated through and well coated in sauce.
Slice open the sub rolls, stuff each with 6 meatballs, top generously with extra warm marinara sauce, and toast under the broiler until heated through and crisp.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Street Corn Bowl with Hot Honey
instructions: Bake or air fry the sweet potato fries according to package instructions until crisp.
Meanwhile, sauté the diced yellow onion and ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat with chili powder, salt, and pepper until cooked through, then drizzle with hot honey.
In a separate bowl, toss the corn, mayo, sour cream, queso fresco, lime juice, diced jalapeño, and chopped cilantro together to make the street corn salad.
Divide the crispy sweet potato fries into bowls, top with the hot honey ground beef and corn salad, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Egg Frittata Bake
instructions: Whisk the eggs and milk together in a large bowl with salt and pepper, then set aside.
Sauté the diced onion, bell pepper, and baby spinach in olive oil in an oven-safe skillet until softened, then stir in the diced ham.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables and ham, sprinkle the feta cheese evenly over the top, and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20–25 minutes until the frittata is fully set and golden brown.

recipes.title: Creamy Cajun Sausage Shells
instructions: Boil the pasta shells according to package instructions and set aside; slice the sausages and bell peppers and sauté them in olive oil until browned.
In a large pan, melt the butter, stir in minced garlic, and pour in heavy cream along with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, salt, and pepper, simmering until thickened.
Stir the mozzarella and parmesan into the cream sauce until smooth, then toss in the cooked shells, sausage, and peppers to coat.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Pasta
instructions: Season the chicken breast with paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, then sear in olive oil until cooked through and slice into bite-sized strips.
In the same pan, sauté the red onion, garlic cloves, and sun-dried tomatoes, then pour in the heavy cream and milk, bringing to a simmer.
Stir in the parmesan, baby spinach, and italian herbs until melted and wilted, then toss the cooked pasta and chicken into the sauce to serve.

recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Cheesy Chicken Potatoes
instructions: Dice the potatoes, season with olive oil, paprika, salt, and onion powder, and roast or air fry at 400°F (200°C) until crispy.
Cube the chicken breast, season with mixed herbs and chili flakes, and sear in a hot pan with minced garlic until golden.

In a small pot, whisk together milk, light cream cheese, parmesan, and mozzarella over low heat until smooth, then layer the roasted potatoes and chicken into bowls and pour the garlic cheese sauce over the top.

recipes.title: One Pot Cajun Sausage Pasta
instructions: Slice the sausage and sauté with diced onion and minced garlic in a large pot until browned.
Pour in the chicken broth, heavy cream, fire-roasted tomatoes, farfalle pasta, salt, pepper, and paprika, stirring to combine.
Cover and simmer over medium heat for 12–15 minutes until the pasta is tender, then remove from heat and stir in the cheddar cheese until melted and creamy.

recipes.title: Satay Salmon Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook the rice according to package instructions and steam or roast the broccoli florets until tender.
Whisk together the peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, minced garlic, grated ginger, and lime juice to create the satay sauce.

Pan-sear or air-fry the salmon fillets until cooked to desired doneness, then assemble bowls with cooked rice, sliced avocado, broccoli, and salmon, drizzling the satay sauce over top and garnishing with fresh coriander.

recipes.title: Avocado Lime Chicken Bowl
instructions: Cook the white rice according to package instructions, and blend or whisk the plain greek yogurt, lime juice, minced garlic, chopped cilantro, and salt to create a cilantro-lime sauce.
Season and sear the chicken thighs in a skillet until fully cooked, then slice into bite-sized pieces.
Assemble bowls with white rice, cooked chicken, corn, and sliced avocado, then drizzle with the creamy cilantro-lime sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Poke Bowl
instructions: Cook the white rice according to package instructions and boil or steam the shelled edamame.
Dice and cook the chicken breast in a skillet with the japanese sauce until fully glazed and cooked through.
Divide the white rice into bowls, top with the glazed chicken, sliced cucumber, diced red onion, and edamame, then drizzle with spicy mayo to serve.

recipes.title: Protein Cinnamon Sugar Bites
instructions: Mix the plain greek yogurt, flour, protein powder, baking powder, and salt together in a bowl until a soft dough forms, then roll into small bite-sized balls.
Air-fry or bake the bites (sprayed lightly with avocado oil) at 375°F (190°C) for 8–10 minutes until puffed and golden.
Dip each warm bite into melted butter and roll immediately in a mix of cinnamon and sugar to coat.

recipes.title: Hot Honey Chicken Sliders
instructions: Season 28 oz sliced chicken breast with paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, cayenne, black pepper, and salt.
Cook in a skillet over medium heat with oil, red onion, sweetcorn, and hot sauce until cooked through.
Stir in honey and 3.2 oz cheddar.
Mix 2 tbsp light mayo, 1 tbsp sriracha, and 1 tsp honey for the sauce.
Spread sriracha mayo on 6 brioche buns, top with chicken, 3.5 oz Swiss, pickles, and 8.8 oz mozzarella.
Brush bun tops with melted light butter, garlic paste, and parsley, then bake at 375°F until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Banana Pancakes
instructions: In a bowl, mash 2 ripe bananas with 1 egg and 1 cup milk.
Stir in 1 cup flour, 1 tbsp sugar, and 2 tsp baking powder until just combined.
Heat a lightly greased skillet over medium-low heat.
Pour batter to form pancakes and cook for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown.

recipes.title: Simple Tuna Salad
instructions: In a bowl, combine 7 oz drained white tuna and 1 chopped hard-boiled egg.
Mix in 6 tbsp light mayo, 1 tbsp sweet pickle relish, garlic powder, and 2 tbsp lemon juice until smooth.
Fold in 1 cup shredded cheese if using and serve.

recipes.title: Chilli Lime Shrimp Bowls
instructions: Season 25 oz raw shrimp with garlic powder, smoked paprika, oregano, cayenne, black pepper, and salt; cook in a skillet with oil for 3–4 minutes until pink.
Dice tomato, red onion, pineapple, and mango, then toss with cilantro, lime juice, and salt to make the salsa.
Whisk 3.5 oz Greek yogurt, 2 tbsp light mayo, 2 tsp sriracha, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, honey, lime juice, and water to make the sauce.
Assemble 3 bowls with 1.5 cups cooked rice each, top with shrimp, salsa, 2 tbsp mashed avocado, and chili lime sauce.

recipes.title: Sourdough Smash Burgers
instructions: Place 2 pieces of sourdough with mozzerella in the middle.
Spray both sides with cooking oil and air fry on 395 for 10 minutes.
Take 2.5 oz of beef and smash it into a flat circle on your pan.
Season with salt and pepper, and cook on high for about 2 minutes per side.
Add slice of cheese.
Repeat for a second patty.
Cook sliced onion and jalepeno in same pan for about 2 minutes, reduce to medium.
Then add minced garlic, brown sugar, a splash of white vinegar, and paprika until veggies are carmalized.
Make burger sauce with 2 tbsp ketchup, 1.5 tbsp mayo, and 1/2 tsp mustard.
Put burger together and enjoy!

recipes.title: Breakfast Burritos
instructions: Whisk 8 eggs with salt and pepper, then scramble in a pan until cooked.
Mix scrambled eggs with 7 oz fat free cottage cheese, 5.5 oz low fat cheddar, diced green bell pepper, 6 diced sundried tomatoes, and chives.
Combine 0.25 cup low sugar ketchup, 2 tbsp light mayo, and garlic powder for the sauce.
Spread sauce across 6 low carb tortillas, top each with egg mixture and 8 oz mozzarella total, roll into burritos, and crisp in a pan or bake until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Steak Tacos
instructions: Make Pico de Gallo: Dice the tomatoes and red onion.
In a bowl, combine the tomatoes, onion, chopped cilantro, juice of half a lime, olive oil, and a pinch of salt.
Mix well and set aside.
Make Avocado Sauce: In a blender or bowl, combine the Greek yogurt, avocado, skimmed milk, remaining lime juice, honey, and a pinch of salt.
Blend or whisk until smooth and creamy.
Cook Steak Bites: Dice the flank steak into 1/2-inch cubes.
Heat a skillet over high heat and coat with cooking spray.
Season the steak cubes with chipotle seasoning and salt, then cook for 3–5 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Assemble & Toast Tacos: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Place a mini tortilla in the skillet, top with low fat cheese, cooked steak bites, pico de gallo, and a drizzle of avocado sauce.
Fold and toast for 1–2 minutes per side until the tortilla is crisp and the cheese is melted.
Repeat for all 8 tacos.

recipes.title: Protein Pancake Bowls
instructions: Mix Wet & Dry Ingredients: In a large bowl (or distributed across 4 individual oven-safe ramekins/bowls), whisk together the eggs, 0% Greek yogurt, milk, and honey until smooth.
Add Blueberries: Gently fold in the fresh blueberries, leaving a few to scatter on top of each bowl.
Bake: Preheat your oven to 350°F (180°C).
Divide the batter evenly into 4 oven-safe bowls if mixed in one container.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until the centers are set and a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Allow to cool slightly before serving.

recipes.title: Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwich
instructions: In a blender, combine the cottage cheese, light mayo, 1 fl oz pickle juice, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, 1/4 tsp onion powder, 1/4 tsp salt, dill, and honey, then blend until completely smooth to make the dressing.

Slice the chicken breast into 2 cutlets and set up three shallow bowls: one with flour, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp pepper, 1 tsp oregano, and 1 tsp salt; the second with egg beaten with 1 fl oz pickle juice; and the third with crushed cornflakes.

Coat each chicken cutlet in flour, dip into the egg mixture, press firmly into the crushed cornflakes, spray generously with cooking spray, and air fry at 380°F (190°C) for 12–15 minutes (or bake at 400°F/200°C for 18–20 minutes), flipping halfway through.

In a small microwave-safe bowl, melt the light butter, then whisk in buffalo sauce, brown stevia, 1 tsp smoked paprika, and 1/2 tsp garlic powder before brushing generously over the cooked chicken cutlets.
Toast the brioche buns, layer the bottom bun with coleslaw/sauce, place the glazed hot chicken cutlet on top, and crown with the top bun.

recipes.title: Raspberry Greek Yogurt Bites
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the 0% Greek yogurt, vanilla extract, and sweetener until smooth.
Line a small tray or plate with parchment paper, gently fold the fresh raspberries into the yogurt mixture, and scoop into 4 equal dollops on the parchment paper.
Place the tray in the freezer for at least 40 minutes until the yogurt bites are firm and set.

If using dark chocolate, melt it in a microwave-safe bowl in 20-second bursts, dip the frozen yogurt bites into the chocolate to coat, and place back on parchment paper for 1–2 minutes until the chocolate shell hardens.

recipes.title: Creamy Chipotle Steak Burritos
instructions: Marinate the rump steaks with 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tbsp chipotle paste, and the juice of 1 lime, then sear in a hot skillet for 3–4 minutes per side, let rest, and slice into thin strips.
Cook the white rice according to package instructions, then stir in the juice of 1.5 limes, 1 handful of chopped cilantro, and salt to taste.
Blend the fat-free cottage cheese, 1 tbsp chipotle paste, honey, 0.5 tbsp garlic powder, 0.5 tbsp onion powder, and a squeeze of lime juice until completely smooth.

Mash the avocados with 1 diced red onion, 1 handful of cilantro, juice of 0.5 lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper, and olive oil to make guacamole, then toss the diced salsa tomatoes, remaining red onion, 1 handful of cilantro, lime juice, and salt to make pico de gallo.

Divide the rice, steak, guacamole, pico, chipotle sauce, and mozzarella evenly among the 4 large tortillas, roll tightly into burritos, and toast in a dry skillet over medium heat for 1–2 minutes per side until crisp.

recipes.title: Spaghetti and Meatballs
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the lean ground beef, 2 diced garlic cloves, chopped basil, 2 tsp salt, dried sage, onion powder, grated Parmesan, panko breadcrumbs, and egg, then roll into meatballs and air fry at 380°F (190°C) for 10–12 minutes until cooked through.
Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water according to package instructions, reserving 1.5 fl oz of pasta water before draining.

Heat a pan over medium heat, sauté the remaining 4 diced garlic cloves and chili flakes for 1 minute, then add crushed tomatoes, stevia, and a pinch of salt, simmering for 8–10 minutes until thickened.
Toss the cooked meatballs, spaghetti, and reserved pasta water directly into the sauce, stirring well to coat, and garnish with fresh chopped basil and extra Parmesan if desired.

recipes.title: Crispy Pizza Pepper Bites
instructions: Slice the mini bell peppers in half lengthwise and scrape out the seeds, then spread a thin layer of light cream cheese into each pepper half, press 1 to 2 slices of turkey pepperoni into the cheese, top with the shredded mozzarella and a pinch of dried oregano, and air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 6 to 8 minutes until the peppers are blistered and the cheese is melted and golden.

recipes.title: Whipped Choco-Espresso Mousse
instructions: Add the non-fat Greek yogurt, chocolate whey protein powder, unsweetened cocoa powder, and instant decaf espresso to a small mixing bowl, then use a handheld whisk or fork to beat the mixture vigorously for 60 seconds until light, fluffy, and roughly doubled in volume, before finishing with a pinch of sea salt on top to bring out the chocolate flavor.

recipes.title: Air Fried Ravioli
instructions: Whisk the eggs in a small bowl, dredge each ravioli in the egg wash followed by the panko breadcrumbs until evenly coated, then place them in an air fryer preheated to 385°F and cook for 4 to 7 minutes until crisp and golden brown before serving warm with your choice of dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Pizza Bread
instructions: Beat the egg, dip or brush the plain bread slices, then layer with sliced sausages, crab sticks, shredded mozzarella, and your choice of mayonnaise, chili sauce, or ketchup before baking or air-frying at 375°F for 8 to 10 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling.

recipes.title: Loaded Potato Bowl
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain, and mash them with the unsalted butter, milk, salt, and black pepper until smooth, then coat the marinated chicken breast in the seasoned flour, fry until golden and cooked through, assemble by spooning the chicken over the mashed potatoes, and drizzle with mayonnaise and cheese sauce to serve.

recipes.title: Sausage Rolls
instructions: Flatten each slice of plain bread with a rolling pin, place a cheese slice and cooked sausage on top, roll tightly, dip into the beaten egg, coat thoroughly in breadcrumbs, and bake or air-fry at 380°F for 6 to 8 minutes until golden brown and crispy.

recipes.title: Cheesy Twisted Bread
instructions: Top each plain paratha with sliced sausages, shredded mozzarella, mayonnaise, and chili sauce, cut strips or twist the edges over the filling to seal, brush the top with beaten egg wash, and bake or air-fry at 375°F for 8 to 10 minutes until golden, flaky, and melted inside.

recipes.title: High-Protein Chocolate Fudge Bites
instructions: Heat-Treat Flour: Place the flour in a microwave-safe bowl and heat for 30 seconds to safely kill any bacteria before consuming raw.
Mix: Melt the butter slightly, then combine all dry and wet ingredients in a bowl.
Stir thoroughly until a thick, fudge-like dough forms.
Shape & Chill: Divide the dough evenly into 8 small bites or balls.
Chill in the fridge for 15–20 minutes to set before serving.

recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan Bites
instructions: Combine the shredded mozzarella, Greek yogurt, egg whites, flour, garlic powder, grated Parmesan, and optional parsley or chili flakes in a bowl until a smooth dough forms, shape into small dough balls, and air fry or bake at 375°F for 8 to 10 minutes until golden before lightly brushing with garlic butter spray to serve.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Roll-Up
instructions: Mix the PBfit powdered peanut butter with a splash of water until a smooth, spreadable consistency forms, spread it evenly across one side of the Carb Balance tortilla, place the peeled banana near the edge, and roll the tortilla tightly around the banana.
Crisp the edges of tortilla over low heat in a pan before slicing or serving whole.
Optionally sprinkle some cinnamon on top.

recipes.title: Turkey Cheese Roll-Ups
instructions: Lay the deli turkey breast slices flat on a clean cutting board, spread a thin layer of Dijon mustard across each slice, top each with half a slice of provolone cheese and a pickle spear, and roll each turkey slice tightly around the filling before slicing in half or serving as is.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mini Peppers
instructions: Slice the mini bell peppers in half lengthwise and remove the seeds, then in a small bowl mix together the cream cheese, fresh herbs, and garlic powder until smooth, spoon the mixture evenly into each pepper half, and sprinkle the tops with everything bagel seasoning before serving chilled or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Veggie Dip
instructions: Add the cottage cheese, garlic powder, and lemon juice to a high-speed blender or food processor and blend until completely smooth and creamy, then transfer to a small serving bowl, stir in the chopped fresh dill and chives, and serve immediately alongside the fresh carrot and cucumber sticks for dipping.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Salad Sandwich

ingredients.name: light butter or olive oil spread

instructions: Preheat your air fryer or oven to 400°F (200°C), pat the chicken breasts dry and season lightly with salt and pepper, dip each breast into the beaten egg, coat thoroughly in a bowl mixed with panko, Parmesan, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper, spray both sides with olive oil, and air fry for 10 to 12 minutes (or bake for 18 to 20 minutes) flipping halfway until crisp and fully cooked to 165°F; meanwhile, toast the halved ciabatta rolls with light butter or olive oil spread in a pan, toss the chopped romaine lettuce in a bowl with light Caesar dressing, 1 tbsp Parmesan, and ¼ tsp black pepper, then assemble by placing a cooked chicken breast on the bottom roll, layering with cooked bacon slices, piling on the Caesar salad mix, and closing with the top bun to serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mac N Cheese with Hot Honey Chicken Tenders

ingredients.name: chicken tenders or boneless chicken breast strips

instructions: Boil the elbow macaroni in salted water until al dente and drain, then make the cheese sauce by melting 2 tbsp unsalted butter in a saucepan over medium heat, whisking in 2 tbsp flour for 1 minute, slowly pouring in milk and half and half while whisking until smooth and thickened, and stirring in the sharp cheddar, mozzarella, paprika, salt, and pepper before tossing with the cooked pasta; bread the chicken tenders by dredging in ½ cup flour, dipping in beaten egg, and coating with panko breadcrumbs, air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 12 to 14 minutes until cooked through, toss the hot tenders in a melted mixture of honey, hot sauce, 1 tbsp butter, and garlic powder, then assemble each bowl with a portion of mac and cheese topped with the hot honey chicken tenders and chopped chives.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Pizza Bagels
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C), place the bagel halves cut-side up on a parchment-lined baking sheet, lightly spray with olive oil if desired, spread 2 to 3 tablespoons of pizza sauce onto each bagel half, sprinkle evenly with the shredded mozzarella, top each half with 4 slices of pepperoni, sprinkle with dried oregano and parsley, and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and the pepperoni is slightly crisp before serving hot.

recipes.title: Big Mac Tacos

ingredients.name: finely chopped dill pickles or relish
reduced-fat American or cheddar cheese slices

instructions: Whisk together the Greek yogurt, light mayonnaise, chopped pickles, sugar-free ketchup, yellow mustard, rice vinegar, ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp onion powder, and ¼ tsp black pepper in a small bowl to make the Big Mac sauce and set aside in the fridge; divide the ground beef into 8 equal balls, press one ball flat onto each small low-carb tortilla until it covers most of the surface, season the beef with salt, pepper, and garlic powder, then cook beef-side down in a hot skillet over medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until browned, flip the tortilla over, top each with half a slice of cheese, cover for 1 minute until melted, and assemble by topping with shredded lettuce, diced onions, pickle slices, and a drizzle of the homemade Big Mac sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan with Vodka Pasta
instructions: Bread the chicken breast fillets by dipping in oat flour seasoned with salt, pepper, and oregano, then in beaten eggs, and pressing into crushed cornflakes before air frying at 400°F (200°C) for 12 to 15 minutes, topping with marinara sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan, and returning to the air fryer for 2 to 3 minutes until melted; meanwhile, boil the chickpea penne until al dente, saute the diced onion and minced garlic in olive oil, pour in the vodka to simmer and reduce, stir in the jarred vodka sauce, blend in the Greek yogurt, Parmesan, black pepper, and chili flakes off the heat, then toss the drained pasta in the sauce and serve hot alongside the crispy chicken Parmesan garnished with fresh basil or parsley.

recipes.title: High Protein Pizza Hot Pockets

ingredients.name: plain all-purpose flour or self-raising flour
sliced mini pepperoni or turkey pepperoni

instructions: Mix the low-fat Greek yogurt, flour, baking powder, Italian herb seasoning, garlic powder, and salt together in a bowl until a dough forms, divide the dough into 8 equal portions and roll each portion out flat, spoon a tablespoon of pizza sauce in the center of each dough piece, top with low-fat cheese and mini pepperoni slices, fold and seal the dough edges tightly around the filling to form hot pockets, and air fry or bake at 375°F (190°C) for 12 to 15 minutes until golden brown and cooked through before serving warm or storing to reheat.

recipes.title: Chopped Cheeseburger Brioche Buns
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the ketchup, mayo, mustard, sweet relish, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, ½ tsp garlic powder, and ½ tsp smoked paprika to prepare the burger sauce and set aside; saute the chopped bell peppers and onions on a flat top or skillet seasoned with Burger Royale seasoning, add the ground beef and let it brown before flipping, chop the beef into small pieces on the skillet, season with the Goya Sazón, extra garlic powder, onion powder, and a splash of Worcestershire sauce, mix the beef thoroughly with the cooked peppers and onions, lay 8 slices of pepper jack cheese over the meat mixture until melted, and scoop the cheesy chopped beef onto toasted brioche rolls layered with the prepared sauce.

recipes.title: Loaded Baked Potato Soup

ingredients.name: sliced fresh chives or green onions

instructions: Fry the chopped bacon in a large pot until crispy, remove and set aside while leaving the rendered fat in the pot, melt the unsalted butter into the bacon fat over medium heat, saute the diced yellow onion and minced garlic for 5 minutes until soft, whisk in the flour for 1 minute to create a roux, then slowly pour in the chicken broth and add the cubed Russet potatoes; bring the soup to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes until the potatoes are fork-tender, partially mash or blend the potatoes to your desired consistency, stir in the heavy cream, whole milk, sour cream, shredded sharp cheddar, and half of the crispy bacon until melted and smooth, then ladle into bowls and garnish with extra cheddar, remaining bacon bits, sliced chives or green onions, and cracked black pepper.

recipes.title: Creamy Gnocchi with Spinach & Chicken
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the cubed chicken breast until golden brown and fully cooked, then remove and set aside; cook the potato gnocchi in a large pot of salted boiling water until they float to the surface (about 2 to 3 minutes), drain, then in the same skillet used for the chicken, melt the butter, saute the minced garlic for 1 minute until fragrant, pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, bring to a light simmer while whisking in the grated Parmesan cheese until thick, stir in the fresh baby spinach and dried oregano for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted, gently fold in the cooked gnocchi and seared chicken until coated in the silky sauce, and serve warm garnished with red pepper flakes, fresh parsley, and cracked black pepper.

recipes.title: Crab Rangoon
instructions: Mix together the cottage cheese, canned or real crab, puréed garlic, soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, sriracha, salt, pepper, and green onions in a bowl, tasting the mixture to adjust seasonings as needed, spoon the filling into the 12 wonton wrappers, fold and seal the edges tightly, and air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 6 to 8 minutes until golden and crispy.

recipes.title: Air Fryer OREO Protein Cheesecake
instructions: Add the cottage cheese, non-fat Greek yogurt, egg whites, 50g vanilla protein powder, cheesecake pudding mix, and 8g zero-calorie sweetener to a small blender and process until smooth, fold in the 4 crushed OREO Thins, pour the batter into a 6.5-inch cast iron skillet, and air fry at 250°F (120°C) for 17 minutes before letting cool at room temperature for 30 minutes and refrigerating for at least a few hours (or overnight); while cooling, prepare the OREO frosting by mixing 30g vanilla protein powder, black cocoa powder, and 4g sweetener with cold water until reaching desired consistency, mix the icing using 30g vanilla protein powder, powdered sugar, and cold water, cool both in the fridge, and spread over the chilled cheesecakes before serving.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Crunch Wraps
instructions: Cook the ground beef in a skillet with the taco seasoning packet and ½ cup water until fully browned, lay extra large tortillas on a baking sheet, layer with queso cheese sauce, cooked ground beef, shredded cheese, crushed tortilla chips, shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, and sour cream, fold the tortillas up tightly to enclose the filling, brush the tops with melted butter, place a second baking sheet directly on top to weigh them down, bake in a preheated oven at 420°F (215°C) for 15 minutes, remove the top baking sheet, bake for an additional 5 minutes until crispy and golden, and serve warm with salsa.

recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Beef Pasta Shells
instructions: Boil the shell pasta in salted water according to package directions and drain; heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan, brown the beef mince with garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, then set aside; in the same pan, sauté the chopped onion and diced garlic until soft, pour in the tomato sauce, beef stock, heavy cream, and Italian herbs, simmer until thickened into a creamy garlic sauce, combine the cooked pasta and seasoned beef into the sauce, mix well, and serve topped with grated Pecorino or Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Cheesy Beef Panini Pockets
instructions: Prepare the filling by browning the minced beef with the diced onion, red and yellow bell peppers, minced garlic, tomato paste, ¼ cup water, and seasonings (salt, pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, oregano, cayenne, thyme, all-purpose seasoning) until cooked through, then let cool slightly and fold in the mozzarella; make the quick dough by combining all-purpose flour, baking powder, 1 tsp salt, sugar, milk, and melted butter/oil until a smooth dough forms, divide dough into portions, roll flat, fill each with the beef and cheese mixture, seal into pockets, and press in a panini press or cook on a skillet until golden brown and melted.

recipes.title: High Protein Lasagna Jacket Potatoes
instructions: Prick the potatoes, spray with olive oil spray, season with salt, and bake or air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 40 to 50 minutes until fluffy on the inside and crispy on the outside; prepare the quick bolognese sauce by sautéing the diced brown onion and minced garlic in a skillet, adding the lean beef mince to brown, and stirring in the tomato passata, tomato paste, Italian herbs, garlic powder, salt, and pepper to simmer for 10 to 15 minutes; slice open the cooked jacket potatoes, fluff the centers, and stuff generously with the warm bolognese filling to serve.

recipes.title: Sweet & Sour Eggs
instructions: Fry the eggs in sesame oil until the edges are crispy, drizzle with soy sauce, honey, and chili flakes, and serve hot over rice garnished with sliced scallions.

recipes.title: Feta Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat, scramble the eggs gently until soft, add crumbled feta to cook briefly, and garnish with fresh parsley before seasoning with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Heavy Cream Fried Eggs
instructions: Add heavy cream and a bit of butter to a skillet and bring to a simmer, crack the eggs directly on top, cook until the whites are fully set, and season with salt, pepper, and herbs before serving.

recipes.title: Lahsa (Yemeni Breakfast Eggs)
instructions: Sauté diced onions and garlic in a pan until soft, add diced tomatoes, cumin, chili flakes, and salt, then crack the eggs into the mixture and stir gently until cooked through to serve with bread.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
instructions: Sauté sliced onions, garlic, and bell peppers in a skillet until tender, stir in diced tomatoes, paprika, and cumin, simmer into a thick sauce, create small wells to crack the eggs into, cover with a lid, and cook until whites are set before garnishing with fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Juicy Beef Tacos
instructions: Whisk together yogurt, light mayo, Cholula hot sauce, honey, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, and fresh parsley to set aside in the fridge; line a large sheet pan with chopped onions and bell peppers, spray with avocado oil, season with 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, and 1 tsp cumin, mix, and roast at 180°C (370°F) for 15 minutes; lay ground beef on top, season with 2 tsp salt, 3 tsp smoked paprika, 3 tsp oregano, 3 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp cumin, tomato paste, and chopped coriander, mix well with hands, flatten, score, spray, bake for 6 minutes, break up beef, bake another 6 minutes until crisp, stir in a splash of water, dip low carb wraps into the pan juices, fill with beef and mozzarella, and bake for 12 minutes flipping halfway until crispy.

recipes.title: Pulled Tomato Chicken Garlic Bread Buns
instructions: Season chicken breast with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and Italian seasoning, cook in a frying pan, shred using two forks, then stir in 1 tsp garlic puree, pizza sauce, and 10g mozzarella to melt over a low simmer; microwave 12g light butter with 1 tsp garlic puree and ½ tsp parsley for 10 seconds, toast brioche buns, brush upside-down tops with garlic butter, place butter side down in the pan, load with chicken and remaining mozzarella, pan fry for a couple of minutes, flip to toast the other side, and finish with ranch sauce and dried parsley.

recipes.title: Spicy Lemon Pepper Chicken Sliders
instructions: Marinate spicy chicken in yellow mustard, hot sauce, buttermilk, 1 tsp lemon pepper, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder, and 1 tsp beef bouillon; combine all-purpose flour, baking powder, 1 tsp black pepper, chili powder, 1 tsp garlic powder, and 1 tsp beef bouillon for coating, dredge the chicken, and fry or air fry until golden; toss cooked chicken in hot sauce, honey, and fresh lemon juice, then assemble sliders with a sauce made of mayonnaise, hot sauce, brown sugar, paprika powder, and squeezed lemon juice.

recipes.title: Lobster Topped Mac and Cheese
instructions: Set grill to 350°F, poke holes in potatoes with a fork, cover lightly with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, and grill for at least 1 hour; assemble cheese sauce ingredients (Velveeta, cream cheese, Monterey Jack, Colby Jack, evaporated milk, BBQ seasoning) in a pan and place on the grill for 30 minutes until melted; prepare butter sauce in a Dutch oven with 8 sticks butter, 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp Old Bay, and 1 tbsp chives, and place covered on grill; trim lobster tail shells vertically on top and bottom, remove shells completely while leaving tail attached to meat, coat lightly with olive oil and Old Bay, grill for 6 minutes, flip, paint with butter sauce, grill 6 more minutes, then toss into butter sauce pot; mix melted cheese sauce, pour over boiled noodles, cut baked potatoes in half, top with butter sauce, mac and cheese, grilled lobster tail, chopped chives, Parmesan cheese, extra Old Bay, and more butter sauce.

recipes.title: Gourmet Steak Sandwich
instructions: Mix mayo, grainy Dijon, 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce, hot sauce, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper in a bowl and set aside; sweat sliced onions in butter on low heat, stir in Worcestershire, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper halfway through, and cook low and slow while deglazing with water until deeply caramelized; wrap 2 asparagus spears with 1 slice of bacon and bake until bacon is crisp and asparagus is tender; season flank steak with salt and pepper, sear hard in neutral oil, butter baste with garlic and herbs, rest, and slice thin; toast ciabatta bread with Havarti cheese inside until melted, layer with prepared sauce, sliced steak, caramelized onions, fresh parsley, bacon-wrapped asparagus, a mound of grated Parmesan, black pepper, and additional sauce before serving.

recipes.title: Easy Chimichurri Steak Salad
instructions: Season the steak with salt, black pepper, oregano, red pepper flakes, and garlic powder, then sear in a hot skillet over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side (or until desired doneness), let rest for 5 minutes, and slice into thin bite-sized strips.
In a large salad bowl, combine the chopped Persian cucumbers, halved cherry tomatoes, chopped cilantro, diced red onion, drained Greek chickpeas, and crumbled feta cheese.
Add the sliced steak to the bowl, pour in the chimichurri sauce and fresh lemon juice, then toss everything together until evenly coated and serve immediately.

recipes.title: High-Protein Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls
instructions: Toss chicken thighs with seasonings, olive oil, and lemon juice; bake or air-fry at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes, broil for 3–4 minutes for a charred exterior, rest for 4–5 minutes, chop into cubes, and set aside with juices.

Sauté garlic and onion in butter over medium-low heat for 5–6 minutes until softened and fragrant, add spices and uncooked rice, toast for 2–3 minutes, pour in 600g water, bring to a light bubble, cover, and simmer for 10–12 minutes until fully cooked, checking halfway to mix and prevent sticking.
Whisk together all garlic white sauce ingredients until smooth.
Toss all crunchy slaw ingredients together in a separate bowl.
Portion rice and chicken into containers, then top with white sauce and crunchy slaw.

recipes.title: Southwest Chicken Salad Jar
instructions: Mix Greek yogurt, lime juice, taco seasoning, and salt to form the dressing, then add shredded rotisserie chicken, beans, corn, and chopped red onion into your jar, pour the sauce on top, and shake it up.

recipes.title: One-Pan Mexican Chicken & Rice Bowl
instructions: Season and cook the cubed chicken in olive oil over medium heat until browned.

In the same pan, add the uncooked rice along with the extra spices and let it toast for 1–2 minutes to enhance flavors, then add the onion, bell pepper, black beans, chopped tomatoes, and water or chicken stock.

Mix well, cover, and simmer on low heat for 12–15 minutes (stirring halfway to prevent sticking) until the rice is tender, then mix in the cooked chicken and garnish with fresh chopped coriander/cilantro.

recipes.title: Ground Lamb Gyro Bowl with Lemon-Pepper Rice & Greek Bean Salad

ingredients.name: herbs de Provence or dried oregano

instructions: Combine rice, water, lemon zest, lemon juice, and butter in a pot, bring to a boil, cover, simmer until cooked, and fluff with minced parsley.
Heat a pan with oil spray, brown the ground lamb with salt and herbs de Provence until cooked through and crisp on the edges, then drain excess fat.
Toss diced cucumber, garbanzo beans, cherry tomatoes, and feta cheese in a bowl for the bean salad.
Whisk Greek yogurt, garlic powder, lemon zest, lemon juice, MSG, black pepper, and a splash of water to make the white sauce.
Divide lemon-pepper rice into bowls, top with ground lamb, Greek bean salad, and slather with high-protein white sauce.

recipes.title: High-Protein Jjajangmyeon Meal Prep
instructions: Heat a pan sprayed with avocado oil, add minced garlic, onions, zucchini, and spring onions, and sauté until softened.
Add the lean ground beef, season with salt and black pepper, and cook until browned.
Stir in the black bean paste and sweetener to taste, then pour in the cornstarch slurry and simmer until the sauce thickens into a glossy coating.
Boil udon noodles according to package directions, divide among meal prep containers, ladle the black bean meat sauce over top, and garnish with fresh sliced cucumbers.

recipes.title: Korean Sticky Chicken Skewers and Rice

ingredients.name: G Hughes Sugar-Free Sweet Chili Sauce

instructions: In a large bowl, combine sliced chicken, hot sauce, sweet chili sauce, and half of the chopped green onions, then marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
In a separate bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar alternative, ginger paste, garlic, red pepper flakes, rice wine vinegar, and keto honey to prepare the glaze.

Thread marinated chicken onto skewers, preheat air fryer to 400°F (200°C), spray basket with avocado oil, and air fry skewers for 25 minutes (turning and brushing with sauce every 5–6 minutes until caramelized).

Air fry pineapple chunks at 400°F (200°C) for 4 minutes (stirring halfway), then assemble containers by dividing rice, adding pineapple on the side, topping with skewers, brushing with remaining sauce, and garnishing with sesame seeds and green onions.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cheesecake Overnight Oats
instructions: Whisk together milk, vanilla Greek yogurt, strawberry protein powder, Jell-O cheesecake pudding powder, and vanilla extract in a large bowl until smooth.
Stir in oats and freeze-dried strawberries until fully incorporated, then portion evenly into meal prep jars.
Seal and refrigerate overnight (or for at least 6 hours) to set, top with crushed vanilla wafers right before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Pesto Tortellini Meal Prep
instructions: Season and cook the chicken thighs in a pan or oven until internal temperature reaches 165°F, then dice into bite-sized pieces.
Boil the cheese tortellini according to package instructions until al dente, then drain.
Toss the cooked tortellini, diced chicken, pesto sauce, mini mozzarella balls, and fresh baby tomatoes together in a large bowl until well coated, then divide into meal prep containers.

recipes.title: Roasted Garlic Feta Beef Pita Wraps
instructions: Slice the top off the garlic head, drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil, wrap in foil, and roast at 400°F (200°C) for 35–40 minutes until soft.
Blend the roasted garlic, Greek yogurt, feta, lemon juice, salt, and pepper in a food processor until smooth and creamy.
Brown the extra-lean ground beef over medium-high heat, season with paprika, oregano, garlic powder, cumin, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1–2 minutes.
Warm the pitas for 15–20 seconds, spread a generous layer of the garlic feta sauce, and assemble with lettuce, tomatoes, cucumbers, red onion, and seasoned beef.

recipes.title: Creamy Buffalo Chicken Pasta
instructions: Season chicken breasts with ranch seasoning, garlic & herb seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, and smoked paprika, cook until internal temperature reaches 165°F, then shred or chop.
In the same pan over low heat, stir cream cheese, low-cal buffalo sauce, and a splash of heavy cream until smooth and creamy.
Mix in cooked high-protein pasta, fold in shredded mozzarella and cheddar until completely melted, combine with chicken, and divide into 6 meal prep containers.

recipes.title: Soup Dumpling Lasagna
instructions: Finely chop the Chinese cabbage and spring onions and add to a large bowl.
Add the pork mince, minced garlic, minced ginger, oyster sauce, mirin, sugar, soy sauce, Chinese cooking wine, sesame oil, chicken vegeta seasoning, and water.
Mix thoroughly until combined, then spread the meat mixture evenly into heatproof dishes and top with a layer of dumpling wrappers.
Splash a thin layer of water over the dumpling wrappers, wrap tightly with aluminum foil, and bake at 180°C (350°F) fan-forced for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Banana Bread Pancake Bowls
instructions: Combine oats, vanilla whey protein powder, monk fruit sweetener, baking powder, cottage cheese, ripe banana, eggs, and almond milk in a blender.
Blend until completely smooth and pour batter evenly into 2 greased oven-safe bowls.
Top with sliced banana and chocolate chips.
Bake in the oven at 180°C (350°F) for 30–35 minutes, or microwave for 3–4 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Herb Chuck Roast Meal Prep
instructions: Lay the diced onion, cubed baby potatoes, baby carrots, and chuck roast in the crockpot with a bit of oil and optional cubed butter.
Whisk together the chicken broth, apple cider vinegar, soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, and Italian herbs to create the marinade, then pour it over the top.
Cook in the crockpot until tender, then portion into meal prep containers for the week.

recipes.title: Beef Enchilada Pasta
instructions: Boil the macaroni according to package instructions until al dente, then drain and set aside.
In a large skillet or pot, cook the ground beef with the diced onion and bell pepper until fully browned, then drain excess grease if desired.
Season the meat with salt, pepper, paprika, and chili powder.
Stir in the pasta sauce and canned tomatoes, then reduce heat and mix in the Greek yogurt and cooked pasta until evenly coated.
Top with shredded mozzarella cheese, cover until melted, and divide into 4 meal prep containers.

recipes.title: Chipotle Beef & Zucchini Rice Bowls
instructions: Toss the diced zucchini with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper, then air fry at 400°F for 20–25 minutes (shaking every 8–10 mins) or bake at 450°F on a parchment-lined sheet pan for 30–40 minutes.
Blend the beef bone broth, cottage cheese, chipotle peppers, tomato paste, and smoked paprika until smooth, then warm in a saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally and salting to taste.

Heat ½ tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat, brown and cook the ground beef, then stir in 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp vinegar, garlic, salt, cumin, and cinnamon, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant before turning to low.
Microwave the jasmine rice and fire-roasted corn.
Assemble four bowls with ½ cup rice, ½ cup corn, ¼ of the beef, ¼ of the zucchini, and a little over 1 cup of broth, then garnish with lime wedges and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joe Potato Skillet
instructions: Peel and dice the potatoes into bite-sized cubes, toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika, then air fry at 400°F for 20–25 minutes (shaking occasionally) until golden and crispy.
Meanwhile, brown the ground beef with diced onion in a large skillet over medium-high heat and drain excess grease.
Stir in the salt, pepper, onion powder, paprika, and minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the Worcestershire sauce, tomato sauce, ketchup, mustard, and BBQ sauce, then simmer on low for 5–10 minutes.
Fold in the crispy potatoes, top with shredded Colby Jack cheese, cover for 2–3 minutes until melted, and finish with dried parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Bowls
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Season the chicken thighs with salt, pepper, olive oil, Greek yogurt, red onion, garlic powder, paprika, and cinnamon, tossing thoroughly to coat.
Arrange on a baking sheet and bake for 35–45 minutes until golden brown.
Slice the chicken and serve over white rice with tzatziki sauce, adding pan-fried bell peppers, cucumber, or tomato as desired.

recipes.title: High-Protein Greek Chicken Salad Bowl
instructions: Season chicken with paprika and garlic granules, spray with oil, and air fry or bake at 180°C (350°F) for 15–20 minutes until cooked, then cool and chop into chunks.
Place corn in a lined air fryer, season with salt/pepper, spray with oil, and air fry at 180°C for 15–20 minutes until charred.
Whisk together Greek yogurt, olive oil, chipotle paste, lemon juice, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Toss diced cucumber, red onion, chicken, herbs, half the feta, 1 tbsp parmesan, half the corn, and dressing together in a bowl.
Top with remaining feta, corn, and 1 tbsp parmesan, then serve as is or with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Hot Honey Cucumber Chicken Salad
instructions: Slice or dice the cucumber and onion into a bowl.
Add the cooked chicken breast, low-fat cottage cheese, and diced avocado.
Drizzle the hot honey over the top and season generously with salt and chilli lime seasoning before tossing to combine.

recipes.title: Green Goodness Scoopable Salad
instructions: Finely chop the green cabbage, cucumber, and rinse/drain the chickpeas, placing them into a large bowl.
In a blender or food processor, combine spinach, basil, green onions, avocado, shallot, garlic, nutritional yeast, olive oil, lemon juice, red wine vinegar, and salt until smooth.
Pour the green dressing over the chopped salad and mix thoroughly until evenly coated.

recipes.title: Massive Fat Loss Buffalo Chicken Salad
instructions: Blend together the Greek yogurt, buffalo sauce, fat-free cottage cheese, ranch seasoning, light mayo, pickle juice, garlic powder, onion powder, white vinegar, and black pepper until smooth.
Place the romaine mix and canned chicken into a giant bowl.
Pour the blended dressing over top and toss thoroughly.

recipes.title: Seared Steak Mango Salad
instructions: Bring steaks to room temperature and preheat oven to 400°F.
Cube the fresh mango and crumble the goat cheese.
Heat a stainless steel skillet on high, lightly coated with avocado oil.
Pat steaks dry, season with salt and pepper, and sear for 2–3 minutes per side.
Transfer skillet to the oven and bake for 10–14 minutes until desired doneness (120–125°F for medium-rare), then let rest for 5 minutes.
Plate arugula with cubed mango and goat cheese, slice steak over top, drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.

recipes.title: Cheesy Buffalo Chicken Ranch Taquitos

ingredients.name: La Banderita Carb Counter mini tortillas

instructions: Season raw chicken with half the taco seasoning and olive oil, then cook in a pan over medium-high heat until done and shred with two forks.

Return shredded chicken to the pan with remaining taco seasoning, buffalo sauce, water (slowly adding until creamy), ranch seasoning, light cream cheese, and diced spring onion, stirring until well combined.
Portion filling evenly into warm mini tortillas, top each with 30g low-fat cheese, and roll tightly.
Spray a pan with light cooking oil spray and pan-fry taquitos on all sides until golden brown and crispy.

recipes.title: Scallion Oil Noodles with Honey Soy Chicken
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil.

Cut 4 scallions into 1-inch pieces and add to a saucepan with 30g avocado oil over low/medium heat until lightly charred; stir in 1 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp dark soy, and 15g honey, simmer 1 minute, turn off heat, stir in black vinegar, and set aside.
Cook chicken mince in a wok over medium heat with 1 tsp avocado oil, 1 tbsp dark soy, 15g honey, garlic, and Shaoxing wine until fully browned.
Boil noodles and Chinese broccoli in salted water until tender, drain, and toss with scallion oil sauce, chicken mince, sliced remaining spring onions, and optional egg yolks.

recipes.title: Loaded Sweet Potato & Ground Beef Meal Prep
instructions: Pierce the sweet potatoes with a fork, then microwave the butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon together before brushing the mixture over the potatoes and baking at 350°F for 1 hour directly in oven-safe meal prep containers.

While those bake, heat olive oil in a skillet over low heat and sauté the diced onion for 2–3 minutes before adding the ground meat, taco seasoning, tomato paste, minced garlic, water, and optional hot honey, cooking until the meat is fully browned and cooked through.
Make the side guacamole by mashing the avocados and mixing in the diced red onion, tomatoes, serrano, chopped cilantro, and lime juice.
Assemble by topping each baked sweet potato with ¼ of the beef and ¼ cup of grated Monterey Jack cheese, serving the guacamole on the side.

recipes.title: Ham & Egg Cups
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F, lightly spray a muffin tin with cooking spray, and press 1 slice of deli ham into each of the 9 cups.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole eggs and egg whites, then divide the mixture evenly among the ham cups and top each with the low-fat Mexican cheese blend.
Bake for 12–15 minutes until the eggs are fully set, then let cool for 5 minutes before removing from the tin.

recipes.title: Spicy Coconut Beef Broth Bowls
instructions: Add all of the broth ingredients to a pot and bring to a gentle simmer, cooking for 20 minutes while stirring occasionally.
In a separate pan, cook the ground beef with the onion, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and sriracha until fully browned.
Serve the seasoned beef over jasmine rice in bowls, pour the simmered coconut broth around it, and top with sliced fresh cucumbers and a drizzle of chili oil.

recipes.title: Braised Short Ribs with Garlic Confit Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°F (165°C), pat the short ribs dry, season with salt and pepper, and sear all sides in olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat until deeply browned before setting aside.
Lower heat to medium, sauté the onion, carrots, and garlic until soft, then stir in tomato paste for 1 minute before deglazing with red wine and scraping up browned bits.
Return the short ribs to the pot along with beef broth, thyme, rosemary, and bay leaf, cover, and braise in the oven for 2.5 to 3 hours until fork-tender.

While braising, make garlic confit by slow-roasting peeled garlic cloves covered in olive oil at 250°F (120°C) for 2 hours, then boil peeled potatoes until tender, drain, and mash with the garlic confit, garlic oil, Greek yogurt, salt, and pepper.
Serve the short ribs over the mashed potatoes, spooned with braising sauce and carrots, and top with chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Chicken with Cacie e Pepe
instructions: Pat chicken thighs dry, season with lemon juice, paprika, garlic powder, parsley, oregano, salt, and pepper, then sear skin-side down in a skillet until golden before transferring to an oven or air fryer at 400°F for 15–25 minutes.
Blanch rapini in salted boiling water for 1–2 minutes, drain, and cook spaghetti until al dente in the same pot while reserving pasta water.
In a pan over medium heat, melt butter, add garlic, red pepper flakes, and black pepper, then toss in the pasta and rapini.
Gradually stir in pecorino romano and reserved pasta water until a creamy sauce forms, adjusting consistency as needed.
Plate pasta, top with extra pecorino and black pepper, and serve alongside two crispy chicken thighs drizzled with pan juices.

recipes.title: Spicy Vodka Pasta
instructions: Heat a generous squeeze of olive oil in a pan over medium heat, adding the diced shallots and chopped garlic to cook until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste to the pan and sauté, stirring continuously, until it darkens and turns a deeper brown color.
Pour in the vodka to deglaze the pan and release tomato flavors, then pour in heavy cream along with basil, red pepper flakes, Italian seasoning, black pepper, and salt, stirring until uniform.
Stir in butter and parmesan along with reserved pasta water to emulsify, then toss in boiled, drained rigatoni pasta until coated throughout.

recipes.title: Easy High-Protein Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C) and mix Greek yogurt, self-rising flour, and protein powder in a bowl to form a sticky dough.
On a floured surface, roll the dough into a 10–12" round roughly 1/4" thick and transfer to a parchment-lined baking sheet or pizza pan.
Parbake the plain crust for 7–8 minutes until starting to set, then remove and spread pizza sauce evenly over the top.
Sprinkle with shredded mozzarella, arrange turkey pepperoni slices, and top with oregano and red pepper flakes.
Return to the oven for 8–10 minutes until the cheese is melted and crust edges turn golden, then slice, garnish with fresh basil, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Crispy Cheesy Beef Taquitos with Avocado Sauce
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, cook diced onion in olive oil until translucent, add ground beef, and cook 6–8 minutes until browned before draining excess grease.

Stir in garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, oregano, cumin, coriander, paprika, chipotle powder, beef bouillon, salt, pepper, and tomato paste, cooking 2–3 minutes before adding a splash of water and simmering 10–12 minutes.
Warm flour tortillas, add spooned beef filling and mixed cheese, roll tightly into taquitos, and secure with toothpicks.
Fry taquitos seam-side down in 1–2 inches of hot oil (350°F) for 2–3 minutes per side until golden, then drain on paper towels.
Blend avocado, mayonnaise, olive oil, garlic, cilantro, lime juice, adobo seasoning, salt, and pepper until smooth to create the dip.

recipes.title: Gochujang Beef & Creamy Noodle Bowls

ingredients.name: Trader Joe’s squiggly knife cut noodles

instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil, and whisk together the noodle sauce packets with maple syrup, coconut aminos, rice vinegar, and the white parts of the sliced green onions.
Blend low fat cottage cheese, gochujang, and 1/4 cup water until smooth, then set aside.

Fully cook extra lean ground beef in a skillet, letting one side sit untouched to form a crispy browned crust, then pour in the maple-soy sauce mixture and simmer 2–3 minutes to reduce and caramelize.
Boil noodles for 4 minutes, drain (reserving 1/2 cup noodle water), and toss noodles with blended gochujang cottage cheese sauce, loosening with reserved water as needed.
Fold 2/3 of the crispy ground beef into the creamy noodles, then plate and garnish with the remaining beef and reserved green onion tops.

recipes.title: In-N-Out Animal Style Loaded Fries
instructions: Cut potatoes into thin fries, spray with oil, season with paprika, air-fry or bake until crispy, and season immediately with salt while hot.
Mix ground beef with baking soda, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and salt, then cook in a sprayed pan over medium-high heat until fully browned.
Sauté diced shallots/onions with salt, balsamic vinegar, and stevia until dark and caramelized.
Whisk low-sugar ketchup, 0% Greek yogurt, light mayo, mustard, pickle relish, and Worcestershire sauce together to form the burger sauce.
Assemble by layering crispy fries on a plate, topping with melted low-fat cheese slices, seasoned ground beef, caramelized onions, and drizzling sauce over top.

recipes.title: Hashbrown Egg Bowl Meal Prep
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Toss hash browns with olive oil, salt, and pepper, then press evenly into the bottom of a greased baking dish and bake for 18–22 minutes until golden and crispy.
Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Remove hash browns from oven, layer sausage evenly on top, pour egg mixture over everything, and sprinkle shredded cheese across the surface.

Return dish to the oven and bake for 20–25 minutes until eggs are set in the center, then sprinkle with chopped chives, cool slightly, slice into 4 equal portions, and store in airtight containers in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.

recipes.title: Scrambled Egg Turkey Taco Bowls
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C), toss diced potatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper, then roast for 25–30 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and tender.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat, add ground turkey along with chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder, then cook for 6–8 minutes until browned and fully cooked.
Whisk eggs with a pinch of salt, pour into a nonstick skillet over medium heat, and gently scramble until fluffy and just set.
Divide roasted potatoes evenly into 4 containers, add scrambled eggs, spoon turkey on top, and finish with shredded cheese, salsa, and herbs before storing in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.

recipes.title: Chick-fil-A Inspired Breakfast Meal Prep
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 400°F (200°C), spray chicken bites with oil, and air fry for 10–12 minutes until crispy and golden.
Air fry or bake tater tots according to package directions until crispy.
Whisk together eggs, milk, salt, and pepper, then melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat and scramble eggs until soft and fluffy (about 3–4 minutes).
Whisk light mayo, honey, BBQ sauce, yellow mustard, Dijon mustard, and optional lemon juice together in a small bowl until smooth.
Divide tater tots, scrambled eggs, and chicken bites evenly among 4 glass meal prep containers, adding a small sauce cup of Chick-fil-A sauce to each container.

recipes.title: Starbucks-Inspired Spinach Feta Egg White Wraps

ingredients.name: whole wheat tortillas or Trader Joe’s Whole Wheat Lavash Flatbreads

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and line or grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Whisk or blend eggs/egg whites until smooth, pour into the dish, and top evenly with chopped spinach, sun-dried tomatoes, salt, black pepper, and crumbled feta.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until eggs are set, then allow to cool slightly and cut into 6 equal portions.
Spread optional cream cheese on each flatbread, place an egg portion in the center, fold sides in, and roll tightly.
Optionally toast each wrap in a skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side, then wrap in foil or parchment to store in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.

recipes.title: Steak Fajita Prep Bowls
instructions: Rinse rice well, bring to a boil in a saucepan with water, then cover and simmer over low heat until tender and liquid is absorbed.
Season sliced steak strips in a bowl with smoked paprika, ground cumin, chilli powder, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat, cook steak strips for 2–4 minutes until browned, then remove and set aside.
Cook sliced onions and bell peppers in the same pan for 4–5 minutes until softened, stirring in minced garlic for the final 30 seconds before tossing steak back into the pan.
Divide cooked rice evenly into 4 meal prep containers, top with steak fajita mixture, cherry tomatoes, diced avocado, lime wedges, and fresh coriander.

recipes.title: Mini Greek Yogurt Muffins
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together plain Greek yogurt, maple syrup, vanilla, and melted butter until combined, then whisk in eggs.
Add all-purpose flour, salt, baking soda, and baking powder to the bowl, stirring just until combined before folding in mini chocolate chips or sprinkles.
Spray a mini muffin pan with nonstick cooking spray and fill cups with batter.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 12–15 minutes until set, let cool, and serve.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Ground Beef Bowls
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, add diced bell peppers, onion, and optional serrano peppers with a pinch of salt, cooking for 5–6 minutes until tender-crisp before setting aside.
Add extra lean ground beef to the pan and cook for 2–3 minutes until browned on one side, then break apart and fully cook.
Combine coconut aminos, oyster sauce, honey, water, fish sauce, garlic, and Thai basil, then add sauce to the beef and cook for 1–2 minutes until basil wilts.
Return cooked vegetables to the pan, toss together, and serve over 1 cup of steamed jasmine rice per portion with lime wedges, cilantro, roasted peanuts, rice vinegar, and chili crisp.

recipes.title: Bacon, Brie, and Blueberry Grilled Cheese
instructions: Add blueberries, sugar, and water to a pan over medium-low heat, cooking for 10–15 minutes until sauce thickens and blueberries can be easily crushed with a fork.
Spread blueberry jam onto sourdough slices, then layer with thick slices of triple creme brie and crispy bacon.
Coat outside of bread with butter, mayo, or olive oil and toast sandwich in a pan on medium-low heat for about 5 minutes on one side and 2–3 minutes on the other until golden and melted.

recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Sliders & Mac and Cheese
instructions: Marinate sliced chicken breasts in garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon, paprika, black pepper, salt, olive oil, and buttermilk.
Mix all-purpose flour with paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, salt, and cumin, coat the marinated chicken pieces, and cook until golden and crispy.
Boil elbow pasta until cooked and drain.

Melt butter in a saucepan, stir in flour, chicken bouillon, garlic powder, chili powder, and heavy cream to create a roux sauce, then melt in mozzarella and cheddar before stirring in cooked pasta and garnishing with parsley.

recipes.title: High-Protein Pepperoni Pizza Calzones

ingredients.name: low fat grated cheese 50% less fat

instructions: Mix plain flour, 0% Greek yogurt, and salt in a bowl to form a dough, then divide into 6 equal balls and roll each into a flat circle.
Spread pizza sauce over one half of each circle, top with low-fat grated cheese, turkey pepperoni, and chopped parsley.
Fold dough over filling to form calzones and crimp the edges tightly with a fork to seal.
Spray calzones with cooking spray and bake or air fry at 375°F (190°C) for 12–15 minutes until golden brown and cooked through.
